title: Registry Entity Record
description: Canonical record for every connected/operational object in OneMind. Lives in the KV_ENTITY_REGISTRY bucket and is emitted on the registry.entity.{id} subject. An entity is any robot, drone, agent, node, sensor, camera, ship, TAK user, or other addressable thing on the bus.

id.description: Stable, globally unique entity identity (e.g. 'node.zeus-mac', 'robot.go2-01', 'agent.legacy', 'sensor.greenhouse-temp-01'). Matches the actor identity model.

kind.description: Entity class — determines how the entity is rendered and which CoT type it maps to.

status.description: Current operational status of the entity.

source.description: The source/connector that registered this entity (e.g. 'omd', 'homeassistant', 'om-unity', 'tak-bridge').

subjects.description: NATS subjects this entity publishes or listens on. Wildcards allowed.

visibility.description: Projection visibility flags — which surfaces should display this entity.

tak.description: Whether this entity should be projected into TAK as a CoT marker.

atoc.description: Whether this entity appears in the omos-atoc control-plane console.

feed.description: Whether this entity's events appear in the UI feed.

legacy_watch.description: Whether Legacy should actively watch this entity for attention-worthy signals.

tak.description: TAK projection metadata. Required only when visibility.tak is true.

cot_type.description: CoT type string (e.g. 'a-f-G-U-i-I' for infrastructure, 'a-f-A-M-F' for friendly drone). See TAK-PROJECTION.md CoT mapping table.

label.description: Label shown on the TAK marker.

location.description: Optional geographic location for map projection. Omitted for entities without a meaningful position.

hae.description: Height above ellipsoid in metres. 0 for ground assets.

last_seen.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last known activity from this entity.

metadata.description: Free-form domain-specific metadata (model, hardware, battery, etc.).
